source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: The f726e1d8e7ad2efefa509a2881796db7c86662b0 test focuses an attachment before clicking the message-header trash button. AttachmentListController maps generic cmd_delete and cmd_shiftDelete to attachment deletion; the patched header uses message-specific command names. The test comment states that attachment removal also emits DeleteOrMoveMsgCompleted. It therefore waits for that event and separately asserts that the message view row count fell by one. This result assertion distinguishes message removal from a same-named completion notification. The companion focus test compares Services.focus.focusedElement instead of the message document activeElement. The fixed accepted attachment test later adds unified-toolbar coverage, which this patch does not own. All inspected direct assertions have non-empty messages. No deletion, focus or keyboard test ran. Full assigned discussion remains pending.
title: The header-delete regression test checks message removal beyond the folder event
